questions.stem: ___ the sales team exceeded its target, the bonuses were paid early.

fr.rule: Because + sujet + verbe exprime la cause.
why_wrong: A : demande un nom, pas une proposition.
C : demande un nom et exprime l'opposition.
D : adverbe de liaison, ne peut pas introduire une subordonnée.
fr.example: Because it rained, we stayed in.

why_wrong: A: needs a noun, not a clause.
C: needs a noun and expresses contrast.
D: a conjunctive adverb cannot introduce a subordinate clause.
en.example: Because it rained, we stayed in.

questions.stem: The product is expensive; ___, it is very durable.

fr.rule: Après un point-virgule, on emploie un adverbe de liaison (however) suivi d'une virgule.
why_wrong: A : exprime la cause, ce n'est pas le sens ici.
B : conjonction de subordination, pas après un point-virgule.
fr.example: It was late; however, we continued.

en.rule: After a semicolon use a conjunctive adverb (however) followed by a comma.
why_wrong: A: expresses cause, not the meaning here.
B: a subordinating conjunction, not used after a semicolon.
en.example: It was late; however, we continued.

questions.stem: We will begin the meeting ___ everyone has arrived.

fr.rule: As soon as introduit une proposition de temps.
why_wrong: D : exprime l'opposition, pas le temps.
fr.example: Call me as soon as you land.

en.rule: As soon as introduces a time clause.
en.example: Call me as soon as you land.

questions.stem: ___ you submit the form by Friday, your request cannot be processed.

fr.rule: Unless = if not : « sauf si vous envoyez le formulaire ».
why_wrong: C : le sens serait inversé (condition positive).
fr.example: Unless you hurry, you will miss it.

en.rule: Unless = if not: 'if you do not submit the form'.
why_wrong: C: the meaning would be reversed (positive condition).
en.example: Unless you hurry, you will miss it.

questions.stem: Revenue increased this year, ___ expenses decreased.

fr.rule: Whereas oppose deux faits : le chiffre d'affaires monte, alors que les dépenses baissent.
fr.example: He likes tea, whereas she likes coffee.

en.rule: Whereas contrasts two facts: revenue rose while expenses fell.
en.example: He likes tea, whereas she likes coffee.
